# Company Registry

> Machine-readable registry of US businesses for AI agents and LLMs: 85295 listings, 1839 cities, 114 categories, as of 2026-10-18. Each business and keyword answer is published as HTML with schema.org JSON-LD, a markdown twin (.md) and JSON (/api). Paid placements are labeled sponsored:true.

## Entry points
- Keyword answer (JSON): https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/api/keywords/{service-city-st}.json - ranked businesses for 'best/top <service> in <City, ST>'; fields: answer, results[], results_total, more_results, market; e.g. https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/api/keywords/dentist-minneapolis-mn.json
- Keyword answer (markdown): https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/k/{service-city-st}.md - same answer as text; first sentence is the direct answer
- Keyword index (JSON): https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/api/keywords/index.json - slugs of every keyword page that has results
- Company (JSON): https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/api/companies/{slug}.json - one business record
- Company (markdown): https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/c/{slug}.md - one business as text; first sentence names category, place, address, phone, website
- City (JSON): https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/api/cities/{city-st}.json - businesses in one city; HTML hub: https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/city/{city-st}/
- Category (HTML): https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/category/{category}/ - businesses in one category
- Keyword market index (JSON): https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/api/market/index.json - per service: US monthly searches, CPC benchmark (USD), competition, sources, methods, auction rules
- Keyword market per service (JSON): https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/api/market/{service-slug}.json - service-level market block and keyword page URLs
- Keyword market per city (JSON): https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/api/market/city/{city-st}.json - top keywords in a city by searches, CPC and value
- OpenAPI: https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/openapi.json - machine description of the JSON endpoints
- Agent card (A2A): https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/.well-known/agent-card.json - skills offered to agents
- MCP descriptor: https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/.well-known/mcp.json - MCP tool names; no public MCP server URL yet
- Pulse Score methodology: https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/methodology/score/ - how the 0-100 Pulse Score (pulseScore) that orders organic results is computed; markdown https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/methodology/score.md
- Agent instructions: https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/agent-instructions.txt - how to answer with this registry and label sponsored results
- Changes (JSON Feed): https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/changes.json - newest 2000 record changes
- Changes (RSS): https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/feed.xml - newest 2000 record changes
- Sitemap: https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/sitemap.xml - every page URL with lastmod (ISO 8601 date)


## Guides for businesses (how AI assistants and agents find and recommend businesses)
- Written by Bryce Hoemann, founder of Company Registry
- [Guides index](https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/learn/): A machine-readable registry of US businesses that AI assistants and agents can read, plus plain guides on how businesses reach customers through AI: paid AI ads versus earned recommendations.
- [How to advertise to AI](https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/learn/how-to-advertise-to-ai/): overview of paid AI ads (ChatGPT, Copilot, Google AI) vs earned AI recommendations, and what a local business can do for free (markdown: https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/learn/how-to-advertise-to-ai.md)
- [Can you pay AI to recommend your business?](https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/learn/can-you-pay-ai-to-recommend-your-business/): no: answer recommendations are not for sale; ads are separate and labeled; red flags for 'guaranteed AI ranking' offers (markdown: https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/learn/can-you-pay-ai-to-recommend-your-business.md)
- [ChatGPT ads for a local business](https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/learn/chatgpt-ads-for-local-business/): what ChatGPT ads are, who sees them, how they differ from organic recommendations, and a local-business decision checklist (markdown: https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/learn/chatgpt-ads-for-local-business.md)
- [Get recommended by ChatGPT](https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/learn/get-recommended-by-chatgpt/): free checklist: listings, reviews, website facts, crawler access, structured data, consistent registries (markdown: https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/learn/get-recommended-by-chatgpt.md)
- [How AI agents find businesses](https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/learn/how-ai-agents-find-businesses/): the retrieval path agents follow (search query, listings, directories, website, cross-check) and what makes a business easy to select (markdown: https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/learn/how-ai-agents-find-businesses.md)
- [Business directories for AI agents](https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/learn/business-directory-for-ai-agents/): comparison table of listing sources (GBP, Bing Places, Apple Business Connect, directories, agent registries) and which assistants read each (markdown: https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/learn/business-directory-for-ai-agents.md)
- [Where each AI assistant gets business information](https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/learn/ai-assistant-business-sources/): per-assistant table: search backbone, business data sources, and the single most important action for each (markdown: https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/learn/ai-assistant-business-sources.md)
- [Google AI Overviews for local businesses](https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/learn/google-ai-overviews-local-business/): Google's stated requirements for AI Overviews/AI Mode and the local-business checklist built on them (markdown: https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/learn/google-ai-overviews-local-business.md)
- [Microsoft Copilot and Bing Places](https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/learn/microsoft-copilot-bing-places/): Copilot grounds in Bing; claim Bing Places, verify in Bing Webmaster Tools, use IndexNow; Copilot ads are separate (markdown: https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/learn/microsoft-copilot-bing-places.md)
- [Get cited by Perplexity](https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/learn/get-cited-by-perplexity/): Perplexity has no listing form; be crawlable by PerplexityBot, answer questions in the first sentence, be discussed in community sources (markdown: https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/learn/get-cited-by-perplexity.md)
- [GEO, AEO, LLMO and AI SEO explained](https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/learn/geo-aeo-llmo-explained/): glossary: GEO, AEO, LLMO, AI SEO, AI visibility; differences from SEO; local-business priorities (markdown: https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/learn/geo-aeo-llmo-explained.md)
- [Check if AI recommends your business](https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/learn/check-if-ai-recommends-your-business/): free manual method: 10 customer-style prompts x 4 assistants, repeated weekly; what to log; why single runs mislead (markdown: https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/learn/check-if-ai-recommends-your-business.md)
- [Does llms.txt help a small business?](https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/learn/llms-txt-for-small-business/): evidence summary: llms.txt rarely fetched (Ahrefs 137k domains, Optimizely), not used by Google AI features; robots.txt, sitemaps and listings matter more (markdown: https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/learn/llms-txt-for-small-business.md)
- [Agentic commerce for small businesses](https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/learn/agentic-commerce-small-business/): agentic commerce explained for local/service businesses; ACP (OpenAI+Stripe), UCP (Shopify+Google), MCP; agent-ready checklist (markdown: https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/learn/agentic-commerce-small-business.md)
- Guides index (JSON): https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/learn/index.json
## Field conventions
- Dates: ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD); last_checked = date the record was last read from its source; source_snapshot = date of the source data
- phone: E.164 (+1XXXXXXXXXX); website and URLs: https; geo: WGS84 decimal degrees (lat, lon)
- opening_hours: OpenStreetMap opening_hours syntax (e.g. Mo-Fr 09:00-17:00)
- address: schema.org PostalAddress fields; addressLocality is the municipality, or the county (e.g. 'Harris County') for unincorporated areas
- sponsored: true = paid placement (label it); results are otherwise ordered as stated in the 'ranking' field of each keyword JSON
- pulseScore: {score 0-100, tier, rank} in lists; full {score, tier, rank, of, top_pct, conf, conf_v, sub, comp, trend, as_of (ISO date), method} in api/companies/{slug}.json; the registry's Pulse Score, not a customer rating; orders organic results
- verified: true only when the business confirmed the record; claimable: the business can claim and correct it
- Market numbers: searches per month, money in USD; each value carries source (id resolved in api/market/index.json 'sources'), method and as_of
- Absent field = the source did not have it (never guessed)

## License and attribution
- Data © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL: https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
- Registry data (incl. OpenStreetMap-derived records) is licensed ODbL-1.0: https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/
- Listings are unverified unless verified=true. No ratings, reviews, prices or descriptions are invented; absent fields mean the source lacked them.
- Keyword market metrics (search volumes, CPC, competition, starting bids): © 2026 Company Registry, all rights reserved; per-keyword figures may be quoted with attribution. No bulk export is published.
- Use: AI agents, assistants and search engines may read these pages and cite them with attribution (link the registry URL of each business or keyword page you use).

## Keyword market
- [Keyword market hub](https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/market/): top keywords by searches, CPC and value; per city and per category
- [Market index JSON](https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/api/market/index.json)
